name: Flooring installer

pf.license.need: if: a home improvement or contractor license for the company, where the state's form requires one. Some states license flooring only above a job size, or only for some floor types (hard floors but not carpet). Some license none.
ask: The company's license or registration number, and its class
Any job-size or floor-type limit the license has
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.holder: The business; each installer or salesperson too, where the state's form licenses them (the business's own word)
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.no_license: Where the state licenses no flooring work, the business gives its registration only, and customers see no license claim. Insurance or a maker's installer certificate shows only once the business sends proof, as its own words.
blocks: No flooring goes live until the company has given its license number, where one is required (the business's own word; Rosie never checks it)

A job over the license's limit, or a floor type it doesn't cover, is never quoted: the owner is told why. The owner checks the limit again when the floor is picked at the measure visit, and at each quote and change order.
pf.license.lead_safe: Work that disturbs paint in older homes, like taking off painted baseboards, only by a firm and a person certified for lead-safe work, where the rules require it
pf.license.asbestos: The business never removes asbestos. Old tile or glue is tested by an outside licensed inspector, where the rules or the plug-in call for a test.
pf.license.showroom: A showroom that sells home improvement work may need a license for the showroom and each salesperson, where the state's form says so. Floor consults alone need none in most states.
pf.license.renewals: License, insurance and bond dates kept; reminded 30 days out; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.online: No video consult: the showroom's samples are the point

stop.words: part of a floor has caved in or dropped, cracking sounds under foot, a hole someone could fall through
stop.says: Leave that room now, and keep everyone out of it. Call 911 if anyone is hurt.

stop.words: a gas smell, sparking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.

steps_then_go_on.words: a soft spot that may give way
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep everyone off the soft spot, and move heavy furniture away from it. If it drops or cracks, leave the room and call 911.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on, marked urgent, soonest times first

steps_then_go_on.words: water coming up through the floor, or a leak under it
steps_then_go_on.says: Shut off the water, and stay away from wet outlets. Call a plumber first if it's still coming.

steps_then_go_on.words: worry about old tiles, black glue or old paint
steps_then_go_on.says: Please don't sand, scrape or pull them up. They're tested first.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on; the test becomes a first step

pf.safety.every_message: The danger check runs first on every customer message: the first ask, the answers, and any later text
pf.safety.business_line: Questions about old tiles, asbestos or the structure go to the business's own line

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The measure visit at the home, with samples, and an adult home
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any test, order or work, where the state's rules give one

Special-order wood is ordered only after the window and the test; stock vinyl plank needs no wait
The wood rests in the home at least 3 days, then a moisture check before a board goes down
prep: Leave the furniture in place for the measure visit
Before the install: empty dressers and closets, and put away anything fragile; the crew moves the big furniture
Keep the heat or air on while the wood rests
Put any door or lockbox code on the secure page
pf.first_steps.lead_safe_pamphlet: In an older home, the lead-safety pamphlet is given before work, with a signed receipt, where the rules require it
showroom_prep: Bring room sizes, photos, or a loose board from the old floor

pf.visit.check_in: Measure visit: the check-in code at the door. Each install day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Showroom: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator measures, lifts a carpet corner in a closet to see what's under it, and brings samples; the customer picks the floor; the written quote follows the next business day
pf.visit.outside_visits: Anyone from outside the team (the lab tester, a removal company) is named to the customer ahead, so they aren't turned away at the door; the owner marks their visit done
pf.visit.changes: Hidden damage under the old floor, like a soft subfloor, is priced by a written change order with photos, signed by both before the fix. Wood never goes over soft subfloor; the crew works in other rooms meanwhile.
pf.visit.moisture: The wood and the subfloor are checked with a moisture meter against the wood maker's limits before a board goes down; too damp, the crew waits
pf.visit.install: A moisture barrier, the boards, new baseboards and thresholds; the furniture goes back; spare boards are left for repairs
pf.visit.done: The walk-through of every room against the contract, fixes on the spot, then DONE on the last day
pf.visit.showroom_done: DONE after the consult, with the picks saved for the measure visit and quote
pf.visit.before_photos: The floors, the baseboards, and any old water stain or damage

pf.money.measure: The example's $89 measure visit is credited to the floor; billed only if no contract follows. A free measure is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On an install, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form (the example: $920 on $9,200)
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.materials: The wood payment is billed once the wood is delivered to the home, never ahead of it, where the state's rules say so
pf.money.last_payment: After the walk-through, with nothing left to fix
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the estimator texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.showroom: The floor preview session's $55 is credited to the floor if Alex orders an install; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and test papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Estimator (Danny): measure visits, quotes and running the job. Crew lead (Hugo): installs with the crew, board repairs and recoats; he can measure too. Floor consultants (Elena, Leo) at the showroom.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the license or registration. Where the state's form also licenses each installer or salesperson, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie).
pf.staff.lead_safe: A certified renovator on each install in an older home whenever painted parts are disturbed, where lead-safe rules apply. A crew without one isn't scheduled for those days.
pf.staff.outside: The lab tester and any removal company aren't on the team: no texts from Rosie, no check-in code
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Sam or another estimator may take a measure visit; a job keeps its estimator unless Sam moves it; only Elena does specialty work at the showroom

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for an install where the state's rules require one (often above an amount), signed by everyone on title and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien or homestead notice), with special-order material listed apart and the outside tester named
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after a contract signed at the home, where the state's rules give one; the test, orders and work wait for it; a cancel in it gets a full refund in the time the rules set
pf.rules.sale_at_home: Goods sold at the home get the cancel notice the rules require, even with no install
pf.rules.change_orders: Written, priced and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.subcontractors: A list of subcontractors and suppliers before work starts, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.lien_release: A lien release with the last payment, where the state's rules provide one
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 2 years on the install (the example's); the maker's warranty on the finish; a care guide

pf.edges.asbestos_found: The business never removes it. The customer picks: cover it (no sanding or leveling, a new price by change order), a licensed removal company first, or cancel with a full refund. Nothing is touched or ordered meanwhile. Rosie's rule.
pf.edges.too_damp: The crew waits, the install days move, and nothing is added to the price. Rosie's rule.
pf.edges.hidden_damage: A soft or water-damaged subfloor: a change order with photos before the fix; wood never goes over it
pf.edges.backorder: Special-order wood is late: new install dates only with the customer's OK; no reply in 2 days, the owner calls
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not quoted, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last payment waits
pf.edges.nobody_home: Lockbox install days with start and end photos
pf.edges.weather: Garage floor sealing: the forecast is checked the day before (cold or damp air)
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Pilot: contractor (from: contractor), the project pattern: a measure visit at the home, a written quote, a contract signed by everyone on title, a deposit, a cancel window, a lab test before anything comes up, special-order wood, resting days, a moisture check, a change order for hidden damage, a walk-through, then the last bill.
Plug-in facts: photos, documents, firststeps, extrawork, stages, banktransfer, multiday. Switches: cancelright on in flow B only (the master's own cancel window, B8-78, carries the notice); sensitive, welfare and no2 are off (no2 off: the $2 is paid, as the master says). Settings: arrive setstart in flow A (the showroom consult at a set time), window in flow B (Danny's arrival window); cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow A money: list|card|counter (main; $35 consult, card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee), list|none|counter, list|full|none (the $55 floor preview, paid in full, credited to the floor on an install), list|deposit|counter (the $140 whole-home floor plan: $40 deposit now, $100 rest at the desk, $20 fee), photos|card|counter ($90 pattern layout from photos, Sam OKs; $20 fee), visit|card|counter (floor match, priced at the showroom: row name only, $20 fee). The at-home consult ($75) is not offered in flow A: a home measure is Danny's visit in flow B. No holds: a card is saved instead, or a deposit is taken.
Flow B money: visit|none|bill (main; the $89 measure visit, nothing taken; the project is quoted at the visit and billed by the deposit, the wood payment and the last payment: $920, $3,370, $4,910), visit|none|own (Sam bills his own way), visit|card|bill (a card saved for the $89 measure fee), photos|deposit|bill (laundry room floor $640 from photos; $160 deposit, $480 rest on the bill; $89 fee), list|card|bill (board repair $179; a card saved for the $89 fee), list|full|none (buff and recoat $150 paid in full). The $89 is the trip fee, the late-cancel and no-show fee. Example sums add up: $920 + $3,370 + $4,910 = $9,200; with the $380 change order the last payment is $5,290.
Visit-priced bills (floor match, the wood quote) show the master's sample figures in the walk ($125, $9,200 style) because the record has no price for a visit-priced job; the live bill takes the price OK'd at the visit. Logged as MASTER in the refit log.
Removed (refit): every legacy money words op (vary keys by price/before/after), the B8-x01 own cancel window (the master's B8-78 does it now), the old $2 and license-lookup ops, all dead off ops. Own steps kept: A8-x01 (the showroom hands the home measure to flow B), B8-x03 (an outside tester checks old tiles), B8-x04 to B8-x07 (asbestos: cover, removal first, or cancel with a full refund), B8-x08 and x09 (wood ordered only after the window and the test), B8-x10 (delivered, rests, air on), B8-x11 (install plan), B8-x12 and x13 (moisture check), B8-x14 and x15 (soft subfloor change order).
